observations.explanation: The paper evaluates ten datasets across arithmetic, commonsense, and symbolic reasoning (pp. 2, 4–5). It reports PS+ outperforming Zero-shot-CoT on all ten (pp. 5–6).
Table 2 reports PS+ at a 76.7 average, above the listed Zero-shot-CoT (70.4), PoT (73.5), PS (72.9), and Auto-CoT (75.9) averages (p. 6).
The limitations section explicitly says prompt design takes effort and GPT-3 models are sensitive to prompt expressions, requiring careful design (p. 9).
The main-paper experiments report results using text-davinci-003 (p. 5). The paper does not establish transfer to other model families, so that remains unresolved.
